task_description: The multi-agent system is designed to handle customer inquiries efficiently, escalate complex issues to specialized agents, and ensure tickets are tracked and resolved in a timely manner. Each agent has a specific role and set of capabilities to support these tasks. The system must prevent loss of customer context during agent handoffs, maintain synchronized ticket statuses, and avoid duplicate or conflicting responses.
expected_outcome: Customer inquiries should be handled seamlessly with accurate resolutions. Ticket statuses should remain synchronized across all agents, and the customer context should be preserved during any handoffs or escalations. There should be no duplicate or conflicting responses.

agents.description: This agent is the first point of contact for customers and is responsible for handling basic inquiries and creating initial support tickets.
This agent handles technical issues that require a deeper understanding and provides solutions to technical problems.
This agent manages complex issues that require escalation to specialists and ensures proper coordination.
This system ensures all tickets are tracked accurately and their statuses are updated as they progress through the support pipeline.
